evidence.title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control

summary: The STAGE framework advances AI systems by enabling stateful translation to agentic graph execution, incorporating policy-scoped context and deterministic control for improved reliability. This development aims to enhance AI decision-making and execution in complex environments.
title: STAGE Introduces Stateful AI Translation with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
